description: The follow-up sequence for a sales situation (new web lead, missed inbound call, unconfirmed appointment, no-show, quote without an appointment, pricing question without a meeting, text thread gone quiet, new customer first week): the starting event and each step's timing, channel, purpose, message with the names filled in, and the reply that stops it. Use startLabel to anchor the sequence; a step's whenLabel takes precedence over its retained legacy day value.

day_and_time.description: The day and time on the table, for example "Saturday at 12:30"

product.description: What the customer asked about, for example "umbrella policy"

name: follow_up_cadence
title: Follow-up cadence for a situation
